candidates.description: This feature activates on Thai script characters and Thai language tokens, occasionally co-occurring with English pharmaceutical terms.
This vector activates strongly for tokens containing the Thai consonant 'น' (noo).
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai tonal vowel and tone mark combinations, particularly those involving the low-class consonant tone patterns.
This vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (so suea) and words containing it, along with isolated subword tokens ending in this character.
This vector activates on the Thai consonant letter "ท" (tho thahan) and its combinations within words.
This feature vector is related to common Thai vowel clusters and sub-syllabic orthographic components.
This vector activates in response to terms related to cannabis and cannabinoids.
This vector represents the character 'k' and its phonetic, graphical, or transliterated equivalents across various writing systems.
This vector activates strongly on specific consonant and vowel combinations found in Thai script alongside common English alphabetic abbreviations and acronyms.
This vector represents a multilingual mixture of subword suffixes and unrelated foreign script fragments.
